message.content:
Ticagrelor is a cyclopentyl triazolopyrimidine compound, so its tablets in measured doses for retail sale fall under heading 3004. Ticagrelor's chemical structure contains a triazolo[4,5-d]pyrimidine ring, which is a heterocyclic compound with nitrogen hetero-atoms only.

For finished dosage forms, subheading 3004.90 ("Other") applies. The statistical suffix for 3004.90.92 is "Other", and ticagrelor (Brilinta) is commonly entered under 3004.90.9290. I am relying on memory for that suffix and have not confirmed it against the current schedule.

Other possibilities in this area are 3004.90.9255 and 3004.90.9250. I did not check them, and I chose 3004.90.9290 as the catch-all.
